governance/guardrails/profanity-hap.title: Profanity (HAP)

Pre-LLM custom governance agent — rewrite or block user input before retrieval and generation
Post-LLM custom governance agent — rewrite or block the generated answer

governance/pii-detection.title: PII detection
gaps: Extra PII names list — add personal names a general model will not recognise (PII tab > NeuralSeek PII Detectors)

governance/red-team-testing.title: Red team testing
governance/red-team-testing.description: Automated adversarial testing of a single agent — planned, executed and graded by agents, across five attack categories.
gaps: Governance > mAIstro Governance > Red Team Testing
The 5 test categories: Prompt Injection, Data Exfiltration, SQL Injection, Unauthorized Access, Service Disruption
Costs — the plan, every test and the review are all billable runs

Replay Agent (mAIstro mode) — the agent used when replaying an interaction
Test connection button — validate the logging endpoint before saving

governance/corporate-document-filter.title: Corporate document filter
